description: Search EU trademarks (EUTM) at the EUIPO — "find EU trademarks containing NIKE in Nice classes 9 and 25". Use for EU brand clearance and competitor trademark portfolios. Returns matching marks (application number, mark text, status, owner, Nice classes, filing date) plus raw. Example: euipo_search_trademarks({ verbal_element: "nike", nice_classes: [9, 25], status: "REGISTERED", _apiKey: "client_id:client_secret" })

_apiKey.description: EUIPO OAuth credentials as "client_id:client_secret" from dev.euipo.europa.eu.

applicant.description: Applicant / owner name to match, e.g. "Nike Innovate".

nice_classes.description: Nice classification classes to filter by, e.g. [9, 25].

query.description: Advanced: raw RSQL filter passed through verbatim (e.g. verbalElement=="*nike*";niceClasses=in=(9,25)). Overrides the friendly params above.

status.description: Trademark status filter, e.g. "REGISTERED", "APPLICATION_FILED", "EXPIRED". Comma-separate for multiple.

verbal_element.description: Text/word element of the mark to match (wildcards added automatically), e.g. "nike". Multi-word values are quoted safely.

name: euipo_search_trademarks
title: Euipo Search Trademarks
